hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has separate entries for Yitha Yitha [xth] and Dadi Dadi [dda] but they are close enough linguistically to be one and the same language which may be called Lower Darling-Lower Lachlan (**hh:hvw:Waferetal:New-South-Wales**, **hh:e:Beveridge:Riverina**). See also: Lower Darling-Lower Lachlan [NOCODE_Lower-Darling-Lower-Lachlan].
